facts.text: The Opportunity Scholarship covers tuition up to full need for Ohio residents who receive a Pell Grant or whose families earn $60,000 or less.

sources.title: Otterbein Scholarships & Awards
sources.quote: covers the direct cost of tuition, up to the student's full financial need as determined by the FAFSA. Awarded to: Ohio residents whose families earn $60,000 or less, or. Ohio residents who are federal Pell grant recipient.
